title: Greatsword Cultist - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Greatsword Cultist in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Dark is the only element that lands, and its Chromatic form drops Sireso.

sections.title: Where to Find the Greatsword Cultist
How to Beat the Greatsword Cultist
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Dark is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.
